# Copilot instructions (wwhisper / PAL)

Read `AGENTS.md` at repo root — it is the master rule set for coding agents.

Additional notes for Copilot:

- Suggest completions consistent with `docs/PAL_DOMAIN_MODEL.md`; never invent new states or fields inline — propose a doc update instead.
- Follow `docs/PAL_SECURITY.md` rules in all generated code, including examples and tests.
- Path-specific guidance lives in `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md`.
